items.title: Isaiah Morgan Interview, 1958-12-01
items.q: We had Jim Robinson on trombone.

ctx.x: Trombone was, uh, Yankee. And his, uh, they only had six pieces. But they didn't make no recording until I take him with us. See, they was trying to, seems like they were trying to double cross him after he got sick, figured he couldn't play anymore. And trying to put Willie Pajot in his place when they went to Mobile. They went down there and they made a failure. So, the man came and told him, says, uh, that wasn't Sam Morgan Band. What do you heard? So, I told him, I said, we'll take you with us. Oh, he didn't…
Which hall was this that was with them? The Blar and Ed Blar Hall?

items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: Yeah, we had two trumpet players. Sam Morgan, Isaac Morgan, and the two brothers.

ctx.x: Who was in the band then? You had a trumpet player?
Yeah, we had two trumpet players. Sam Morgan, Isaac Morgan, and the two brothers. Mm-hmm.

items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: Sam. No, the first band, his brother Isaiah Morgan, but Sam, Sam here, his band

ctx.x: Sam. No, the first band, his brother Isaiah Morgan, but Sam, Sam here, his band, his band, the Magnolia band, he had, well, they had a split, you see. Sam had a stroke and he got sick, well, the band split, you see. And after Sam got out, got well, well, he come with his brother and put the band on the Sam name because he had all the work and everything, you know. He's more famous. Put everything in his hand.
So now you joined Isaiah first.
